# LocalCloud

LocalCloud is a local Google Cloud runtime that brings major GCP services into a single Docker container — no cloud account, no credentials, no cloud costs. Teams develop against real GCP APIs locally, then switch to production by unsetting emulator environment variables.

## What It Is
- A single Docker container running 20+ GCP service emulators
- Same SDKs, same APIs, zero code changes
- Free for individual developers (evaluation, learning, personal projects)
- Built-in web console at localhost:8080 for inspecting service health and data

## Services Provided
- Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, Firestore (official Google emulators)
- BigQuery (custom DuckDB-based emulator, ~96% SQL coverage)
- Spanner (extended official emulator with PostgreSQL interface)
- Bigtable (custom emulator with change streams, materialized views)
- Memorystore (Redis-compatible cache)
- Secret Manager, Cloud Tasks, Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring (local facades)
- Cloud Workflows (full stdlib, connector shims)
- GKE, Compute Engine, Cloud Run (opt-in, Docker-backed)
- Vertex AI, Cloud KMS, Cloud SQL (planned)

## Quick Start
```
docker pull jaysen2apache/localcloud
docker run -d -p 8080:8080 -p 4443:4443 -p 8085-8087:8085-8087 \
  -p 9010:9010 -p 9020:9020 -p 9050:9050 -p 9060:9060 -p 6379:6379 \
  -m 4g --name localcloud \
  -v ~/.localcloud/data:/var/lib/localcloud \
  jaysen2apache/localcloud
eval "$(curl -s http://localhost:8080/_localcloud/env?format=shell)"
```
